threats.title: Timing Attack on Midtrans Webhook Signature Verification
threats.objective: Prevent signature forgery by remote attackers seeking unauthorized payment settlement
threats.actor_assumptions: Unauthenticated remote adversary measuring response latency variance
threats.prerequisites: Midtrans payment gateway enabled and receiving webhooks
threats.confidence_rationale: Code uses standard string inequality !== instead of constant-time hash_equals(). In cryptographic signature checks, non-constant-time equality leaks character matching times.

threats.title: Ambiguous Order Match via Price Collision in QRISLY Webhook Processing
threats.actor_assumptions: Shopper making concurrent purchases of equal amounts
threats.prerequisites: QRISLY notification received without explicit order_id or invoice identifier
threats.confidence_rationale: Fallback logic searches by grand_total and payment_status=pending without a unique identifier, creating race condition collisions when multiple transactions share the same price.

threats.title: Unattended POS Terminal Impersonation
threats.objective: Prevent unauthorized sales processing or drawer operations during cashier absence
threats.actor_assumptions: Individual with physical proximity to an active cashier station
threats.prerequisites: Cashier opened a shift and left the terminal unlocked
threats.confidence_rationale: EnsureActiveCashierShift validates active shift status but has no idle-timeout or per-transaction PIN authorization.

controls.title: Xendit Callback Token Hash Verification
controls.description: Uses hash_equals($expectedToken, $callbackToken) to protect against timing attacks on Xendit webhooks.

controls.title: Pessimistic Shift & Inventory Locking
controls.description: Applies lockForUpdate on cashier shift and product records inside DB::transaction to prevent concurrent balance drift.

treatments.proposal: Refactor Midtrans webhook signature check to use hash_equals($expectedSignature, (string) $signatureKey).
treatments.tradeoffs: Zero performance cost; closes theoretical byte-by-byte timing leak.

treatments.proposal: Remove amount-only fallback query in QRISLY webhook handler. Enforce mandatory invoice parameter or reject request.
treatments.tradeoffs: Prevents catastrophic cross-transaction payment settlement at the expense of rejecting misformatted vendor payloads.

treatments.proposal: Add client-side inactivity lock after 3 minutes idle time with cashier PIN confirmation requirement.
treatments.tradeoffs: Slight increase in cashier friction, significantly higher physical security.

verifications.criteria: Passes when invalid signature returns HTTP 403 and valid signature passes using hash_equals.
Passes when payload without order_id is rejected with HTTP 422/404 instead of settling arbitrary transaction.

gaps.description: Outbound network firewall egress controls for Midtrans and Xendit IP ranges not visible in application code.
gaps.evidence_needed: Cloud/server firewall (ufw/iptables) rules or reverse proxy configuration.
